views.name: v_app_user_permissions
views.definition:
SELECT au.id AS user_id,
    au.display_name,
    au.email,
    au.role,
    au.legacy_key,
    au.active,
    au.emergency_access,
    aup.id AS permission_id,
    aup.organizacion_id,
    o.nombre AS organizacion_nombre,
    aup.torneo_id,
    t.nombre AS torneo_nombre,
    aup.categoria_id,
    c.nombre AS categoria_nombre,
    aup.equipo_id,
    COALESCE(e.nombre, aup.equipo_nombre) AS equipo_nombre,
    aup.can_view,
    aup.can_load_results,
    aup.can_load_documents,
    aup.can_review_documents,
    aup.can_correct_results,
    aup.can_manage_tournaments,
    aup.can_manage_users,
    aup.can_emergency_override
   FROM app_users au
     LEFT JOIN app_user_permissions aup ON aup.user_id = au.id
     LEFT JOIN organizaciones o ON o.id = aup.organizacion_id
     LEFT JOIN torneos t ON t.id = aup.torneo_id
     LEFT JOIN categorias c ON c.id = aup.categoria_id
     LEFT JOIN equipos e ON e.id = aup.equipo_id;

views.name: v_document_ai_audits_latest
views.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ON ((COALESCE(team_document_id, player_document_id)), scope) id,
    scope,
    team_document_id,
    player_document_id,
    organizacion_id,
    torneo_id,
    categoria_id,
    equipo_id,
    equipo_nombre,
    player_id,
    player_name,
    requirement_id,
    requirement_nombre,
    storage_path,
    file_name,
    file_type,
    audit_status,
    confidence,
    summary,
    findings,
    extracted_text,
    detected_dates,
    valid_until,
    checks,
    criteria_version,
    unresolved_reason,
    page_evidence,
    source_kind,
    source_file_id,
    source_file_url,
    source_modified_at,
    source_hash,
    model,
    audited_by,
    audited_at,
    created_at,
    updated_at
   FROM document_ai_audits
  ORDER BY (COALESCE(team_document_id, player_document_id)), scope, audited_at DESC;

views.name: v_document_audit_results_admin
views.definition:
SELECT dar.id,
    dar.organizacion_id,
    dar.torneo_id,
    dar.categoria_id,
    COALESCE(c.nombre, dar.categoria_nombre) AS categoria_nombre,
    dar.equipo_nombre,
    dar.player_id,
    COALESCE(tp.nombre, dar.player_name) AS player_name,
    dar.alcance,
    dar.planilla_arbitro,
    dar.document_type,
    dar.declared_status,
    dar.located_status,
    dar.validated_status,
    dar.valid_until,
    dar.audit_status,
    dar.risk_level,
        CASE
            WHEN lower(COALESCE(dar.risk_level, dar.audit_status, ''::text)) ~~ '%critica%'::text OR lower(COALESCE(dar.risk_level, dar.audit_status, ''::text)) ~~ '%crítica%'::text THEN 1
            WHEN lower(COALESCE(dar.risk_level, dar.audit_status, ''::text)) ~~ '%alta%'::text THEN 2
            WHEN lower(COALESCE(dar.risk_level, dar.audit_status, ''::text)) ~~ '%media%'::text THEN 3
            WHEN lower(COALESCE(dar.risk_level, dar.audit_status, ''::text)) ~~ '%validado%'::text OR lower(COALESCE(dar.risk_level, dar.audit_status, ''::text)) ~~ '%conforme%'::text THEN 9
            ELSE 5
        END AS risk_order,
    dar.observation,
    dar.evidence_url,
    dar.source_sheet,
    dar.cutoff_date,
    dar.imported_by,
    dar.imported_at,
    dar.created_at,
    dar.updated_at
   FROM document_audit_results dar
     LEFT JOIN categorias c ON c.id = dar.categoria_id
     LEFT JOIN team_players tp ON tp.id = dar.player_id;

views.name: v_drive_player_documents_admin
views.definition:
SELECT dpd.id,
    dpd.organizacion_id,
    o.nombre AS organizacion_nombre,
    dpd.torneo_id,
    t.nombre AS torneo_nombre,
    dpd.categoria_id,
    c.nombre AS categoria_nombre,
    dpd.equipo_id,
    dpd.equipo_nombre,
    dpd.player_id,
    COALESCE(tp.nombre, dpd.player_name) AS player_name,
    tp.dni AS player_dni,
    tp.dorsal AS player_dorsal,
    dpd.document_type,
    dpd.title,
    dpd.drive_file_id,
    dpd.drive_url,
    dpd.mime_type,
    dpd.status,
    dpd.observation,
    dpd.match_status,
    dpd.source_folder,
    dpd.reviewed_by,
    dpd.reviewed_at,
    dpd.created_at,
    dpd.updated_at
   FROM drive_player_documents dpd
     LEFT JOIN team_players tp ON tp.id = dpd.player_id
     LEFT JOIN organizaciones o ON o.id = dpd.organizacion_id
     LEFT JOIN torneos t ON t.id = dpd.torneo_id
     LEFT JOIN categorias c ON c.id = dpd.categoria_id;

views.name: v_player_documents_admin
views.definition:
SELECT pd.id,
    pd.player_id,
    tp.nombre AS jugador_nombre,
    tp.dni AS jugador_dni,
    tp.dorsal AS jugador_dorsal,
    tp.baja_solicitada,
    tp.baja_motivo,
    tp.baja_solicitada_por,
    tp.baja_solicitada_en,
    pd.requirement_id,
    dr.nombre AS requirement_nombre,
    pd.organizacion_id,
    o.nombre AS organizacion_nombre,
    pd.torneo_id,
    t.nombre AS torneo_nombre,
    pd.categoria_id,
    c.nombre AS categoria_nombre,
    pd.equipo_id,
    pd.equipo_nombre,
    pd.uploaded_by,
    pd.storage_path,
    pd.file_name,
    pd.file_type,
    pd.file_size,
    pd.status,
    pd.vencimiento,
    pd.observacion,
    pd.reviewed_by,
    pd.reviewed_at,
    pd.created_at,
    pd.updated_at
   FROM player_documents pd
     JOIN team_players tp ON tp.id = pd.player_id
     LEFT JOIN document_requirements dr ON dr.id = pd.requirement_id
     LEFT JOIN organizaciones o ON o.id = pd.organizacion_id
     LEFT JOIN torneos t ON t.id = pd.torneo_id
     LEFT JOIN categorias c ON c.id = pd.categoria_id
  WHERE tp.activo = true;

policies.name: team_audit_closure_events_select_authorized
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (app_users au
     JOIN app_user_permissions aup ON ((aup.user_id = au.id)))
  WHERE ((au.auth_user_id = auth.uid()) AND (au.active = true) AND (au.role = ANY (ARRAY['asociacion'::text, 'admin_general'::text])) AND (aup.organizacion_id = team_audit_closure_events.organizacion_id) AND (aup.torneo_id = team_audit_closure_events.torneo_id) AND (aup.categoria_id IS NULL) AND (aup.equipo_id IS NULL) AND (aup.can_review_documents = true))))
